correctness.rationale: The bijection with regular seven-vertex tournaments is exact after adding a vertex whose incident edge orientations encode the high/low scores. The fixed-score partial-orientation flow inequalities, checked against Brualdi–Kiernan theorem 3.1, yield the universal cut test on 15-edge supports. Independent complete 32768-support cut enumeration gives coefficients (1,15,105,455,1335,2697,3355,1185) and no shattered 8-edge support. The package enumerates 2640 valid score hypotheses and all 720 vertex permutations to classify the 1185 maximum supports into five types. Importantly, independently loaded the actual original JSON depth-11 certificate blob 48c8f1f919c5c37b9b272c8b902d023fd5d02817, checked every one of its 2048 distinct leaf witnesses belongs to the 2640 hypotheses and agrees with all 11 heap path edge answers, with no errors. Since 2^11<=2640<2^12, the certificate proves Ldim exactly 11; these are truly exhaustive finite domains, not probabilistic samples.
